title: Simple Saddle and Horse Armor Recipe
description: This datapack adds simple and balanced crafting recipes for Saddles and Horse Armor
body: This datapack adds simple and balanced crafting recipes for Saddles and Horse Armor, making these essential items accessible through survival gameplay instead of relying only on loot chests. Players can craft saddles using common materials related to leather and metal, while horse armor can be created using the same resource tier as its protection type, such as iron, gold, or diamond. The recipes are designed to feel natural within vanilla Minecraft progression, rewarding resource gathering without removing the value of exploration. This datapack is lightweight, survival-friendly, and perfect for players who want more consistency and freedom in preparing mounts for travel, combat, and exploration.
